welcome.intro: Import audiobooks you own, keep them on this device, and listen anywhere, including in airplane mode.
welcome.point1: Add MP3, M4A or WAV files from your phone or computer.
welcome.point2: No account and no cloud. Each device keeps its own books.
welcome.point3: Once a book is imported, it plays without a connection.
welcome.installTitle: Install before your first big import
welcome.installBody: On iPhone, books added in Safari stay in Safari. Add Loud Books to your Home Screen and open it from there, so your library lives in the app.
welcome.installCta: How to add to Home Screen

install.title: Install Loud Books
install.body: On iPhone, the installed app keeps its own library, separate from Safari. Install it before adding big books, then always open it from the icon.
install.step1: In Safari, tap Share in the toolbar.
install.step2: Scroll down and choose Add to Home Screen, then Add.
install.step3: Open Loud Books from your Home Screen.
install.other: On a computer or Android, look for Install in the browser's address bar or menu. Using it in a tab works too.

library.subtitle: {count, plural, one {# book} other {# books}} on this device · Works offline
library.subtitleOffline: {count, plural, one {# book} other {# books}} on this device · Offline. Everything here still plays.
library.emptyBody: Add audiobook files you own. They're stored on this device and play without a connection.
library.safariNote: You're using Loud Books in Safari. Books added here stay in Safari, not in the installed app. Install it first if you plan to add large books.
library.single: Books you add or receive will show up here.
library.noResultsBody: Check the spelling, or try a different word from the title.
library.updateReady: An update is ready. Restart to finish installing it.
library.updateBusy: An update is ready. It installs after you stop listening, so playback isn't interrupted.
library.added: Book added. Ready to listen offline.
library.subtitlePreparing: {count, plural, one {# book} other {# books}} on this device · Getting ready for offline use

dataError.title: Your library couldn't be opened
dataError.body: The browser didn't let Loud Books read its storage. This can happen in a private window, or after site data was cleared. Your books aren't shown until storage is available again.

form.coverGenerated: Optional. Without one, Loud Books makes a cover from the title.
form.coverImage: Your image. It will be resized and stored on this device.
form.title: Title
form.titleError: Add a title to save this book.
form.filesHelp: MP3, M4A, M4B or WAV. One file is a whole book; several files become chapters, in order.
form.unsupported: {format} isn't supported yet. Use MP3, M4A/M4B or WAV.
form.mismatch: This file's format doesn't match the other chapters.
form.filesNone: Add at least one audio file.
form.filesError: Remove the files that can't be used before saving.
form.filesChecking: Wait a moment while the files are checked.
form.partsOff: Adds places to jump to every 30 minutes. These aren't the author's chapters, and your audio isn't changed.
form.partsOn: Adds {count} parts, one every 30 minutes, to make it easier to jump around. These aren't the author's chapters.
form.storage: Uses about {size} on this device. The browser estimates about {free} is free for Loud Books.
form.local: Files are copied into Loud Books on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
form.editPlaying: This book is playing. Saving pauses it, and your session is prepared again the next time you press Play.
form.savedPlaying: Changes saved. Your session will be prepared again when you press Play.
form.saveFailed: Some changes couldn't be saved. Check the book and try again.

importing.title: Importing {title}
importing.note: Keep this screen open until it finishes. Everything happens on this device.
importing.quotaBody: This book needs about {need}, and the browser says about {free} is free for Loud Books. Nothing was added, and your other books are fine.

details.singleNote: This book is one file ({duration}). Turn on 30-minute parts in Edit if you'd like places to jump to. Your audio stays as it is.
details.missingBadge: Audio file missing. Re-import it from More.

player.prepMinutes: {minutes} minutes at {speed} covers about {duration} of the book.
player.prepChapter: Preparing up to the end of Chapter {n}.
player.prepAll: Preparing the rest of the book.
player.rebuildPosition: Updating your session for the new position
player.rebuildTimer: Updating your session for the new timer
player.rebuildNote: Time you've already listened still counts.
player.readyBody: Your browser needs one more tap to start audio.
player.endedTimerBody: Next time you press Play, it starts 5 seconds earlier so you can pick up the thread.
player.endedChapterBody: Press Play to start Chapter {next}, “{title}”, from the beginning.
player.completedBody: “{title}” is marked as finished. It stays in your library until you delete it.
player.interruptedBody: Another app or a call took over the audio. Your place is saved.
player.error: This book can't play right now
player.errorBody: Part of the audio couldn't be read while preparing your session. Your place is saved.
player.rewindToast: Starting 5 seconds earlier so you can pick up the thread.
player.nextChapterToast: Starting the next chapter from the beginning.

speed.title: Playback speed
speed.summarySession: At {speed}, your {minutes}-minute session covers about {duration} of the book.
speed.summaryHour: At {speed}, an hour of listening covers {duration} of the book.
speed.rebuild: Changing speed prepares your session again, which takes a moment. Time you've already listened still counts.

timer.title: Sleep timer
timer.c3: End of the chapter after next
timer.offSub: Play to the end of the book
timer.oneLeft: Only one chapter left after this one
timer.minutesError: Enter a number of minutes from 1 to 600.
timer.explain: Loud Books prepares one audio file for this session, so it stops on time even with the screen locked. Pausing doesn't use up your time.
timer.summaryChapterSub: About {duration} of listening. Next time, Play starts Chapter {next} from the beginning.

send.title: Send to another device
send.step1: On your phone, open Loud Books from the Home Screen.
send.step2: Tap Receive and scan this code.
send.step3: Type the 6-digit code your phone shows.
send.waiting: Waiting for your phone · code expires in {time}
send.copied: Pairing link copied. Paste it into Loud Books on your phone.
send.includePositionSub: Sends where you are now, once. The two devices won't stay in sync.
send.enterCode: Type the code shown on your phone
send.wrong: That code doesn't match. {n, plural, one {# try} other {# tries}} left.
send.locked: Too many tries. Close this and choose Send again for a new code.
send.sameWifi: Both devices need to be on the same Wi-Fi network.
send.keepOpen: Keep this tab open, and keep Loud Books open on your phone, until it finishes.
send.verifying: Your phone is checking the files
send.doneBody: “{title}” is on your phone and ready to listen offline.
send.failedBody: The devices couldn't stay connected. Make sure both are on the same regular Wi-Fi network (guest and office networks often block this), then try again.
send.keptFiles: Files your phone already received complete are kept.
send.signalingBody: Sending needs an internet connection for a moment to introduce the two devices. The book itself goes directly between them.
send.stopBody: Your phone keeps the files that already arrived complete. You can send again later.

receive.title: Receive a book
receive.intro: Copy a book from your computer straight into this library. It travels directly between the two devices.
receive.step1: On your computer, open the book in Loud Books and choose Send.
receive.step2: Scan the code it shows, using the scanner here, not the Camera app.
receive.step3: Type the 6-digit code from this phone into your computer. The book arrives in your library.
receive.safari: You're in Safari. A book received here stays in Safari and won't appear in the installed app. For the best result, open Loud Books from your Home Screen first.
receive.wifi: Both devices should be on the same regular Wi-Fi. No account is needed.
receive.cameraBody: Your browser will ask for camera access. It's only used to read the code, and it turns off as soon as the code is found. The microphone is never used.
receive.deniedBody: Allow camera access for Loud Books in your browser settings, or paste the pairing link from your computer instead.
receive.point: Point your camera at the code on your computer.
receive.expiredBody: Pairing codes last 5 minutes. On your computer, close the Send window and choose Send again for a fresh code.
receive.pasteHelp: On your computer, choose Copy pairing link under the code, send it to this phone, then paste it here.
receive.pasteError: That doesn't look like a Loud Books pairing link. Copy the whole link from the Send screen on your computer.
receive.typeCode: Type this code on your computer
receive.codeNote: The code is only valid for this pairing and expires in a few minutes.
receive.keepOpen: Keep Loud Books open on both devices until it finishes. If your phone locks, the transfer pauses.
receive.verifyingBody: Making sure every file arrived complete before adding the book.
receive.success: Your book is ready to listen offline
receive.successBody: {title} is now in your library on this phone.
receive.lostBody: The devices couldn't stay connected. Make sure both are on the same regular Wi-Fi network. Guest and office networks often block this.
receive.lostNote: Files that already arrived complete are kept. Pair again to receive the rest.
receive.storageBody: This book needs about {need}. The browser says about {free} is free for Loud Books.
receive.storageNote: Nothing has been received yet. Your other books are fine.
receive.duplicateBody: “{title}” is already in your library on this phone.
receive.replace: Replace the one on this phone
receive.signalingBody: Pairing needs an internet connection for a moment to introduce the two devices. Listening isn't affected.
receive.stopBody: The book won’t be added. Files received so far will be removed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.cacheSub: Lets multi-file books play to the end without a timer
settings.appFilesSub: Loud Books itself, for offline use
settings.estimate: The browser estimates about {free} is still available to Loud Books. Estimates can be off, so imports still check for space as they go.
settings.protectedBody: The browser won't remove your books to free space on its own. Clearing website data in Settings still removes them, so keep backups of books you care about.
settings.standardBody: If the device runs very low on space, the browser may clear data it hasn't been asked to keep. Installing the app usually helps.
settings.clearTempSub: Removes prepared sessions and the continuous-book cache. Your books and progress stay.
settings.backupsBody: Export a book from its More menu as a .loudbook.zip file you keep yourself. To move a book between your devices, Send is quicker.
settings.installedSub: Opened from your Home Screen. Your library lives here.
settings.browserSub: Books added in the browser stay in the browser. Install the app before adding big books.
settings.offlineReadySub: The app opens without a connection. Imported books always play offline.
settings.updateBusy: It installs after you pause, so we won't restart while you're listening.
settings.license: Free and open-source software, MIT license
settings.privacy: Loud Books has no accounts, analytics or ads. Your books, covers and listening progress stay on this device. When you send a book, a short-lived pairing service introduces the two devices; the book itself goes directly between them and is never uploaded.
settings.deleteLibrarySub: Removes every book and all listening progress from this device. Books on your other devices aren't affected.
settings.preparingSub: Downloading the app files. Keep this open for a moment.

dialogs.discardBody: The title and files you picked won't be saved.
dialogs.discardEditBody: Your edits won't be saved. The book stays as it was.
dialogs.stopImportBody: Nothing will be added to your library. Files copied so far will be cleaned up.
dialogs.deleteBody: This removes the book and its audio ({size}) from this device. It can't be undone. Copies on other devices aren't affected.
dialogs.deletePlaying: This book is playing now. Playback will stop.
dialogs.clearBody: This frees about {size}. Your books and listening progress stay. The next time you press Play, it may take a moment to prepare.
dialogs.deleteLibraryBody: This removes {count, plural, one {# book} other {# books}} ({size}) and all listening progress from this device. It can't be undone.
dialogs.deleteFailed: The book couldn't be deleted. Try again in a moment.
